text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, what should I do! I'm so excited, I 
can't sit still~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine... our outing isn't until the next 
day off, you know? What am I going to do 
with you, getting this worked up already?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! Fufufu, thank you so 
much for the truly wonderful present, 
Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Gorgeous dresses, dazzling jewels—of 
course, I would accept them with heartfelt 
gratitude, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After all, getting to make memories with 
you makes me the happiest. I can't wait 
for our trip, Groove-san~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I hear the camellias at the garden 
we're visiting should be in full bloom 
right about now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't get so carried away in the vast 
garden that you end up getting lost, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're holding tightly onto 
Groove-san's hand♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What? No, I'm not a child anymore, so 
that's—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even my usually overprotective fathers 
gave their permission, I'm so, so glad~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I told her Groove-san was the one who 
invited me, she went quiet right away. 
Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, alright. I shall gladly 
accept this duty of acting as the 
princess's protector."
